The '''''Corellia''''' was a [[Valor-class cruiser]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], it was occupied by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]]. It was noted as having a golden appearance, rather than the typical red-and-gray or orange-and-gray color scheme of Republic warships. The ''Corellia'' was struck by a missile during [[Independent Operation Sebaddon]] and boarded by [[Fastbreeder]]s. The droids overwhelmed and commandeered the ship, destroying it in order to spread themselves throughout the rest of the Republic fleet.
